links.comparator_used: Previous less consistent QA that relied on end-users to report performance drops (informal comparison, no formal test of sensitivity or specificity)
links.outcome: Detection of a performance drop (humerus) after the software upgrade, and outlier flagging of DLS contours
links.effect: Rule 1 flagged 93 outliers (3.0% of 3093 ROIs), of which 12 were human errors. For the humerus, 4 trend shifts were reported for RayStation 2024B versus none for 12A, and the moving average moved outside the control limits. 12 other trend shifts and 1 drift caused only temporary deviations. End-users noticed the same humerus drop.
links.tradeoff: Every alarm required manual investigation (93 outliers reviewed). Sensitivity and specificity were not tested. Control limits were fixed at one point in time, and the optimal sample size is unclear.
links.quote: Simultaneously, end-users recognised the same performance drop in their daily practice, supporting the outcome of the CQA framework.
